description: List the published data tables for a Spanish INE statistical operation (e.g. "IPC", "EPA"), including periodicity, publication name, and start period. Use an operation_code from ine.operations. Data: servicios.ine.es (INE Tempus3 API), no auth required.

operation_code.description: Short code of the statistical operation, from ine.operations (e.g. "IPC" for Consumer Price Index, "EPA" for Labour Force Survey).

name: ine.reference.tables

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: INE Tables for an Operation
